name: dsh-mobile-upgrade
description: Mobile UI fixes for the DeepSeek Harness web profile: a restart row, a narrow-screen drawer with a floating entry point, a scrollable question region, a throttled reaction to streaming message storms, a guarded subagent-catalog refresh, click-to-open lineage chips, a narrow-header collector sheet, a throttled session-list render under background streaming load, and a hover-kept connection card with manual refresh. Binds the host's stable data-* contracts and local class names, never build hashes, so a rebuild cannot silently disable it.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check client/client.js && node scripts/check-manifest.js
